variable.name: des pumpkin
variable.l: Our pumpkin is a sight to behold. Its deep orange hue was the perfect embodiment of fall, and its smooth, unblemished skin hinted at the treasure hidden within.

variable.name: des long beans
variable.l: Our long beans offer a delightful textural contrast in dishes. When cooked properly, they are tender yet retain a satisfying crunch, adding depth and makes a perfect addition to any meal.

variable.name: des lady finger
variable.l: Our ladyfingers provides a good source of essential nutrients like fiber, vitamins (especially vitamin C), and minerals like potassium. They are also low in calories, making them a healthy addition to your meals.

variable.name: des celery
variable.l: Our celery's standout feature is its satisfying crunch. Whether you're enjoying it with a dip, in a salad, or as a garnish, its texture adds a refreshing element to various dishes, even children who dislikes vegetables will love it's crunchiness

variable.name: des cucumber
variable.l: Our cucumbers are extremely low in calories, making them a guilt-free snack or addition to your meals.

variable.name: des potato
variable.l: One of the best things about our potatoes is that they are affordable. They're a budget-friendly option that can stretch your meals without stretching your wallet. This makes them a staple in many households, especially during tough economic times.

variable.name: des carrot
variable.l: While not as rich in vitamin C as some other fruits and vegetables, our carrots provide a decent amount of this essential vitamin. Vitamin C is crucial for collagen production, immune system support, and overall skin health.

variable.name: des red beans
variable.l: Our red beans are a nutritional powerhouse. They're an excellent source of plant-based protein, fiber, vitamins (such as folate and vitamin K), and minerals (especially iron and potassium). They provide a nutrient boost to various dishes and are particularly valuable for vegetarians and vegans.
